reviews_1s:
You have one job: drain. They made this otherwise decent strainer with a CONVEX bottom, which means you get a nice little doughnut shaped puddle in the bottom--the one area of the colander does not have holes. So dumb. I took a ball ping hammer and whacked the convex dome, into a concave depression.States it’s over 10 inches height. It’s under 6.. very inaccurate description in both photos and written.My wife bought this for us to replace the old OXO one. This one is much more narrow and tall with a very narrow base. Sounds great for smaller sinks, right? Nope. Boil a pound of pasta and go to strain it and the motion and mass of the pasta cause the whole thing to fall on its side. Half the pasta goes down the disposal. I will be replacing.

I like most OXO stuff, but this is just a bad design.Have a few other oxo items and they are great but this was disappointing. The holes were stamped from the outside in which resulted in the inside perforations being rough and the outside smooth. The opposite of what a colander should be. It would end up tearing up delicate items like salad leaves.

Additionally, the curve at the bottom of the colander prevents water from flowing through so there is an awkward puddle at the bottom, defeating the purpose of it in the first place.I even tried washing it and there is a ring around the inside that will not come off. Do not feel safe using this for food. You would think for a $50 strainer that it would be nice on the inside and the outside of the bowl .
